summary: Liquid render done and checked in the built Windows player (Build/B1). LiquidRenderer.Create builds the TerritoryField, ActorFieldCamera, LiquidSurface and QualityTier, publishes the shared globals, checks the default volume profile and rebinds on SessionStarted (attract restarts included). TerritoryField: grid-sized VisualMask (RGBA32 linear) driven by events with a visual lag. A Return with cells starts a fill wave over FillDuration 0.35 s in distance order from the return point; a rival's cells leave it when the wave reaches them. An Eliminated player evaporates through _PIO_PlayerFade over 0.6 s and its channel is then cleared. A reconciliation pass runs after every grid change. The clock is the sim's render time, so pausing or slowing the runner pauses or slows the waves and screenshots are deterministic. The pocket mask follows PlayerState.Pocket (Version driven). GPU side: TerritoryBlur.shader runs procedural full-screen-triangle passes (cmd.DrawProcedural, explicit _PIO_BlurSource / _PIO_BlurTexel) in one CommandBuffer through Graphics.ExecuteCommandBuffer in LateUpdate. Each pass is scissored to the dirty rectangle; the full path only runs on bind or when an RT is lost. Passes: Gaussian sigma 1.28 cells with 5 linear taps -> B-spline x2 into the 1024^2 _PIO_TerritoryField (contour and color), plus a second blur (total sigma 0.26 u) -> _PIO_TerritoryHeight (relief, gradient, soft shadow source). ActorFieldCamera: world rectangle = view + 0.6 u, DefaultExecutionOrder 200, half-float RT with a blend check (8-bit fallback with _PIO_ActorScale 0.25), 16-bit depth (needed by URP 17), reallocated on size or tier change. LiquidSurface: static [-40,40]^2 quad, queue 1900, world position in uv1, drawn by the LiquidComposite thin Shader Graph (6 passes compiled, ShaderCheck PASS). LiquidComposite.hlsl draws: the territory layer with fwidth AA and two-color AA at the crease; the actor layer only where max a >= 0.003, with same-color fusion, threads at full height on rival puddles and continuous merging into their own; normals; PIO_ShadeLiquid lighting (normalized wrap Lambert so flat interiors keep the exact palette color, gloss-110 streaks on upper-left edges, broad lobe on High, Fresnel rim, meniscus foot); soft lower-right drop shadows; navy ground with faint grain, darker outside the arena with a rim shadow; 45 degree pocket stripes (55 %, no relief, no gloss); a slow wobble of at most 0.04 u. Quality tiers High / Medium / Low plus the contract 12.4 FPS watchdog, with -quality to force a tier. Debug-only helpers: -debugblobs (stand-in actor contributors, off automatically now that B2's real ActorViews exist) and -renderlab <dir> (a deterministic lab session: touching colors, 45 and 27 degree bands, 1-4 cell strips, a rotated square, an unchased capture with a mid-fill shot, a perf line). Visual verdict against docs/reference_gouttes.png (final shots in docs/waveB/shots/B1): V1 holds (thick rounded glossy edges, white highlight streaks on upper-left edges, darker lower-right rims, soft lower-right drop shadow). V2 holds for puddles (smooth concave neck where B2's thread leaves the puddle, no blister). V5 holds (flat interiors are exactly #F2674F / #22C4B6, deep navy #1E2A4D with grain std about 1-2 levels, like the reference). V6 holds at 540x960 (no staircase on 45 / 27 degree bands or discs; contact lines between colors antialiased; no grid blocks in the High highlights). V8 holds (pocket.png: flat stripes over the teal puddle next to the raised glossy coral home). Perf (whole game, 540x960, this Intel iGPU, -fps 300): High 3.52 ms average / 3.79 ms p95, Medium 3.45 / 3.71.

TerritoryField (plain class, IDisposable, owned by LiquidRenderer): consts FillDuration 0.35f, EvaporationSeconds 0.6f, BlurSigmaCells 1.28f, WideSigmaCells 1.6f, DirtyGrowCells 11, FieldScale 2; ctor TerritoryField(Shader blur); Session, Size, VisualMask, PocketMask, Field, Height, FieldFormat, PlayerFade, ActiveWaves, PassRuns, LastReconcileFixes; VisualOwner(int cell), VisualTime() (sim render time), Bind(GameSession), OnSimEvent(SimEvent), Update(float unscaledDeltaTime), Dispose().

LiquidSurface (MonoBehaviour): consts HalfExtent 40f, RenderQueue 1900; Material, Renderer; static Create(Transform parent, Shader composite). The mesh carries world xy in uv1.

enum RenderTier { High = 1, Medium = 2, Low = 3 } (values match SaveData.Quality) and static class QualityTier: consts WatchdogWarmupSeconds 5, WatchdogWindowSeconds 3, WatchdogRatio 0.83; event Changed; Current, PlatformDefault, IsAuto, WatchdogSteps, ActorFieldScale, Bicubic, CentralDifferences, Shadows, SpecularLobes, BloomAllowed, ShaderFlags (_PIO_Quality); ScaleOf(RenderTier), Refresh(), BeginSession(), Tick(float unscaledDeltaTime, bool running), TargetRate(). Command line -quality high|medium|low (or 1|2|3) forces a tier.

DebugBlobs (MonoBehaviour, -debugblobs): static TryCreate(Transform, GameDirector), Bind(GameSession). RenderLab (MonoBehaviour, -renderlab <dir>): static TryCreate(Transform, GameDirector, LiquidRenderer); writes lab_start / lab_thread / lab_midfill / lab_filled.png and a '[RenderLab] perf frames= avgMs= p95Ms= tier= actorRT= passRuns=' line, then quits 0.

LiquidCommon.hlsl new globals (declared only there): float _PIO_TerritoryUnorm (1 when the field/height RTs fell back to R8G8B8A8_UNorm), float4 _PIO_PocketTexel, float4 _PIO_GroundColor and _PIO_OutsideColor (linear Palette.Background / OutsideArena), float4 _PIO_ArenaShape (half size, corner radius), float4 _PIO_Time (x = unscaled seconds wrapped at 1024); macro PIO_GRAD_RANGE 6.0. B0b's _PIO_Quality proposal is kept as is (x lobes, y shadow taps, z bicubic, w central differences). PIO_Height unchanged; PIO_ShadeLiquid keeps its signature (retuned).
_PIO_TerritoryHeight content: (H of the relief field, dH/dx, dH/dy in world units, max t of the relief field). Only LiquidComposite reads it.
contract_issues: 12.2 shadow formula: smoothstep(0.35, 0.8) of the contour field at the 0.12 u offset makes a band about 3 px wide at 30 px/u, and the edge antialiasing hides it (measured: one darker pixel, no visible shadow; V1 failed). B1 keeps the offset and _PIO_ShadowOffset but reads the relief field (height .w, sigma 0.26 u): ground shadow = 0.62 x smoothstep(0.03, 0.85, t_wide + max a), puddle shadow = 0.40 x smoothstep(0.03, 0.85, max over other colors of a). Own-color actors never shadow their own puddle (they merge into it). Low still has no shadow taps.

12.2 relief: with H = PIO_Height(t) of the sigma 0.16 u field, the rounded edge is about 3 px wide and the lower-right rim barely darkens (-15 %), far from the reference (about 0.5 u of rounded edge). B1 keeps the contour (cT) and color on the contract field. HT and its gradient come from a second blur (total sigma 0.26 u, passes WideH / WideV, same scissored command buffer), and territory normals get a slope gain of 1.7 (PIO_RELIEF_GAIN). On straight edges the contour is the same 0.5 iso. Strips narrower than about 3 cells stay colored but flat.

12.2 actor height: implemented as HA = HT + D with D = H(a_k + t_k) - H(t_k). Off its own puddle this equals the contract's H(max over i != k of t_i) + H(fA) (threads keep full height on rival puddles), and it stays continuous where an actor merges into its own puddle. Deep inside its own puddle D is scaled down to 25 % (PIO_OWN_DOME). Without that, B2's thread neck and the home pearl's neck blob raised a visible blister ring (f > 1 keeps rising). Same-color fusion (fA = a_k + t_k for the coverage cA) is unchanged.

Section 19 says RTs have no depth. URP 17 Render Graph draws nothing into a camera target without one, so _PIO_ActorField carries a 16-bit depth buffer (B0b finding confirmed: the actor field renders). Territory RTs drawn by the command buffer have no depth.

Fetch budget (12.2 item 4), Medium: 6 fetches without actors (field, height, pocket, actor, 2 shadow taps) and 10 with actors (+4 forward differences), within 7 / 12. High uses B-spline taps (4 per field, height and pocket) and central differences, as 12.2 allows.

Contract v1.4 (section 24) and v1.5 (section 25, biomes) arrived while B1 was running. B1 follows v1.4 by construction: a chased Return has empty Cells, so no fill wave plays. Section 25 hooks (BiomeTheme, _PIO_RevealTime / _PIO_Now, per-biome FillDuration, bloom per biome) are wave B-2 work for BI / LIQ and are not implemented here.
open_issues: Screenshots (docs/waveB/shots/B1, all from Build/B1 at 540x960, tier High unless named). devshot_menu.png: attract round behind the menu, a coral puddle with a thread and neck, glossy edges. devshot_ThreadOut.png: the coral disc with B2's thread leaving it through a smooth concave neck, highlight streak on the disc's upper-left edge, soft shadow at the lower right. devshot_CutDroplets.png: B2's droplet chain and retraction front over the navy; the puddle look is unchanged. devshot_PocketPending.png: coral home, rival teal puddle with coral pocket stripes inside the thread loop (V8: stripes are flat, home is raised and glossy), yellow and lilac puddles with drop shadows. devshot_Caught.png: the human's puddle evaporating at the left edge and its pocket erased. lab_high_thread.png: thread crossing a rival strip; 1, 2 and 3 cell strips as glossy rods; 45 and 27 degree saffron bands with no staircase; rotated lilac square with straight edges and rounded corners. lab_high_midfill.png: the unchased capture half filled, liquid front advancing from the return point. lab_high_filled.png: fill complete, coral and teal touching with an antialiased crease. lab_low_filled.png: Low tier, same scene with no shadow taps and one specular lobe.

DevShot's demo no longer shows a fill. Since contract 24 its first return is chased, so it captures nothing: MidFill.png shows a plain return and DevShot logs 'scenario FAIL the first return captured no cell; no LassoPocket...'. The same rule breaks B0a's PlayMode test BootTests.Results_DemoRoundBuildsTheOutcomeAndShowsResultsAfterTheDeathBeat ('one capturing return (debounced) Expected 1 But was 0'); it is the only failure in the PlayMode run (6/7 pass, including Boot_MenuThenRoundRuns, which now runs the LiquidSurface / ActorField checks against the real renderer). The fill wave is covered by RenderLab and by the EditMode test B1_FillWave_DistanceOrderThenEqualsGrid instead.

The full VisualMask is re-uploaded (Texture2D.Apply, 1 MB) on each frame a fill or evaporation changes it (about 21 frames per capture at 60 fps). The GPU passes are scissored, but the upload is not. Fine on PC. Android cost (upload plus passes; budget 0.5 ms GPU per fill frame) is unmeasured: B6 probe on a device.
Bloom (optional, PC High) is not enabled: renderPostProcessing stays false, which keeps the saturated paint exact. Section 25 later wants bloom on High for Fire / Electric (BI / LIQ).

Edges of territories captured along a wobbly path show the path's own small bumps, and near-axis disc edges keep a faint cell-staircase ripple in the highlight streak (visible only when zoomed in 4x or more). An inherent limit of a 0.125 u ownership grid blurred at sigma 1.28 cells.

Whether an Android renderScale < 1 (GameDirector caps it on screens taller than 1920) makes URP put an 8-bit intermediate in front of the half-float actor RT is unverified; it would clamp overlaps above 1. Check on device (B6).
needs: B0a / BI (owner of DemoScenario and BootTests): under contract 24 the demo's first return is chased and captures nothing, so give the demo an unchased capture before the chase (or move MidFill and the 'one capturing return' assertion). Then DevShot MidFill and B6's fill.png show the fill wave again and BootTests.Results_DemoRound... is green.
B4: the HUD count-up can sync on LiquidRenderer.FillDuration (0.35 s); the fill clock is the sim render time (LiquidRenderer.Instance.Territory.VisualTime()).

B2: bead shadow ellipses should use _PIO_ShadowOffset / LiquidRenderer.ShadowOffset (unchanged contract value). An own-color actor over its own puddle now rises only 25 % (no blister around necks and the home pearl), so neck blob amplitudes need no special casing. FYI: in lab_high_midfill.png the human's thread is still drawn during the 0.35 s fill after the return; if that is not the intended fade, B2 may want to dissolve it on the Return event.

B6: '-quality high|medium|low' forces a tier for probe runs; QualityTier.Current gives the tier for the [ProbePerf] line. '-renderlab <dir>' is a deterministic visual harness for the liquid look (exit code 0).

BI (wave B-2, section 25): TerritoryField.FillDuration is a const today; make it per-theme when BiomeTheme lands. _PIO_RevealTime fits in TerritoryField.SetVisual, the single place where a cell changes its displayed owner. LiquidSurface.Create takes the composite shader, so a biome switch can rebuild the material from BiomeTheme.CompositeShader.
